welcome-space.title: Welcome to Collaborative Docs
welcome-space.content:
Welcome to Your Collaborative Space

This is a real-time collaborative text editor built with Next.js. Multiple people can join this space simultaneously and edit content together in real-time.

✨ Features

  • Real-time synchronization: See updates as collaborators type.
  • Active presence: Check the collaborator avatars in the header to see who is currently in this space.
  • Rich formatting: Headings, bold, italic, underline, lists, highlights, code blocks, and alignments.
  • Space Lifecycle: Share the link to invite teammates, or click Destroy Space to permanently purge this room for everyone.
  • Export options: Download your document as Markdown, Plain text, or HTML at any time.
Tip: Open this URL in another browser tab or share it with a friend to experience real-time multi-user editing!
welcome-space.plainText: Welcome to Your Collaborative Space. Real-time text editor with multi-user collaboration.
